note: Fast-simulation models g4sim_run can attach to a fast_sim_envelope (S8). This plan delivers only the hook and two test models; a study's substitute model is added here with its C++ class and validated under hep-ml's protocol by the study, not by the g4sim gates.

idle.description: never triggers: ModelTrigger returns false and draws no random number (S8 gate 3, the idle hook)

absorb.description: triggers on entering the envelope, kills the track and books its kinetic energy as the deposit of that step (S8 gate 3, the closure)
